title: Harness surface
text: Harness surface is not a stored level-row field. Launchable on chips show the viewer's own standing: only projects they may operate and machines they may use contribute eligible surfaces. Native listings and catalog selection still determine which models each eligible surface can launch. Each blocked model row names one reason per supported surface, using the freshest non-retired machine seen within 24 hours that the viewer may use. Duplicate native selectors never repeat a blocker; a missing machine reads "no machine of yours offers <surface>". No separate unavailable-machines list appears.
